invariants: Personal Year, Personal Month and Personal Day are produced from one exact target date and one explicit reduction policy.
The public cycle API delegates to the already-bound Pythagorean personal-day arithmetic so DailySnapshot and numerology screens cannot diverge silently.
singleDigit and preserveMasterNumbers are distinct explicit policies.
Different YYYY-MM-DD target dates retain distinct identity.
remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Requirement-state promotion must be backed by the workflow/test evidence rather than source presence alone.
